data.title: 丰川祥子 · 和解后的合奏
data.description: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来；弹奏中她闭了闭眼——「命运未必相同，内心共鸣如一」，这是她学会的、最珍贵的一件事。
data.action: 练习室，她重新坐在键盘前与旧伙伴们合奏，阳光从窗外进来
data.camera: wide ensemble shot, keyboard foreground and bandmates visible behind
data.promptProse: Sakiko Togawa plays the foreground keyboard with her eyes briefly closed, cream knit top and blue trousers framed by ribbon-tied blue hair. Four former bandmates join separately: a vocalist at the microphone, guitarist and bassist facing inward, and drummer at the rear. Music stands connect their rehearsal positions in the wide view. Afternoon window light crosses keyboard keys and their playing hands, with instrument shadows anchoring each musician within the shared room.
